thread:
carlos_csm: FYI signal from StellarCart — they just spun up 2 new teams (analytics + fraud ops) and asked for a throughput estimate for embeddings and realtime chat. renewal in 6 months, so could be an expansion win or churn risk if onboarding stalls.
alyssa_cs: Nice catch. Do we have current qps/embeds baseline for them?
mike_solutions: I pulled their dashboard earlier — avg embeddings = 120k/day, peak qps ~85 in EU region last week. They mentioned a pilot that could add ~3x tokens if they enable dedupe + realtime scoring.
carlos_csm: @alyssa_cs baseline: 120k/day embeds, 10k chats/day, burst up to 85 qps. Their account rep (julie) says analytics wants daily batch retrain + realtime fraud scoring.
julie_cust: Confirming — analytics team will run daily 10M-token ingests for retraining features, fraud ops want <200ms tail for short inference calls. Priority: accuracy for analytics, latency for fraud.
alyssa_cs: That latency requirement is tight. We should propose dedicated pool or reserved capacity for fraud team. Renewal talk can include reserved pricing.
mike_solutions: Agree. Options: dedicated GPU pool pinned to a low-latency model + caching for fraud signatures. For analytics batch we can recommend quantized model + larger batch windows to save cost.
sam_pm: Can we run a capacity delta estimate? @infra-bot can you run a quick capacity calc for +3x embed volume and a dedicated low-latency pool for 2 pods?
infra-bot: Capacity calc requested by sam_pm — estimated additional GPUs: 2 x a100 (for dedicated low-latency) + 1 x a40 equivalent for batch embeddings. Estimated monthly cost delta: ~$18k. (ETA full calc 2h)
carlos_csm: Great — infra calc will help the proposal. Also we should schedule enablement sessions: one for analytics (ingest patterns, batching), one for fraud (latency SLOs, model pinning). Julie — can you share the list of engineers & timelines?
julie_cust: I'll send the list today. Targeting staging ramp next week, production in 3 weeks if all goes well. Also raising concern: security team needs VPC peering for private deploys — they flagged compliance checks.
mike_solutions: For VPC peering we can route them to Redwood Private or set up dedicated infra for dedicated. I'll loop in eng-privacy on the checklist.
alyssa_cs: Action items: (1) infra to finish capacity calc (infra-bot) (2) proposals: pricing + dedicated config (mike_solutions) (3) enablement schedule (carlos_csm + julie_cust) (4) compliance checklist (mike_solutions). I'll own outreach to renewals with a summary.
carlos_csm: Sounds good. Risk note: if staging slips >2 weeks, they may re-evaluate vendors before renewal. Let's aim for docs + 2 enablement workshops in next 10 days.
sam_pm: I'll book tentative slots and ping eng-privacy.
julie_cust: Thanks team — appreciate the fast turnaround. Will post the engineer list this afternoon.
alyssa_cs: :thumbsup: I'll pre-draft the renewal expansion packet once infra calc is in.
infra-bot: Capacity calc complete — details posted to /mnt/shared/stats/stellarcart_capacity_2475001111.csv
carlos_csm: Received, will review and convert to proposal. tagging @mike_solutions for pricing draft.
mike_solutions: On it — drafting now, should have a first pass in 4 hours.
julie_cust: FYI their fraud lead prefers a canary rollout before full production. Keep that in the plan.
carlos_csm: Noted. Closing loop later today with a plan and owners. Thanks everyone.
